authorization: Publisher authorised three verified daily company-analysis articles on 2 November 2026, superseding the repository's one-new-article daily cap.
story_thesis: Contract value grew only 2.5% while a sharply lower share count amplified EPS; durable per-share growth needs subscription demand and free cash flow to reaccelerate.

identity.units: USD thousands except per-share and contract-value data

duplicate_checks: Checked editorial index, both inventories and actual wealth Markdown; Gartner had a maintained /stocks/it/ profile but no contract-value or buyback analysis.
Checked open PRs 57 and 43, recent merged publication PRs, company-publication records and live content; no matching Gartner story or fingerprint was active.
Checked the 4 November Europe/Dublin scheduled publication count before drafting; no scheduled new company-analysis article had been published.
This analyses subscription economics and capital allocation; routine figures remain on /stocks/it/.
candidate_review_reference: See a5b5496690fd217fbefcd647.json for the eight-company batch screen; Gartner was selected independently.

evidence_table.claim: Contract value was USD5.3bn, up 2.5% year on year FX-neutral; GTS grew 2% and GBS 4%.
GTS retention was 85% and wallet retention 98%; GBS retention 87% and wallet retention 99% versus 102%.
evidence_table.result: verified; wallet-retention interpretation is Compound analysis

evidence_table.claim: Insights revenue was USD1.292bn, up 2%, and gross-contribution margin improved to 78% from 77% with an USD8m personnel-cost reduction.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Release segment table and 10-Q Insights MD&A.
evidence_table.result: verified; lower-headcount explanation attributed to management

evidence_table.claim: Gartner repurchased 886,818 shares for USD138.223m in Q3 and 7.827m shares for USD1.220bn over nine months.
Diluted weighted-average shares fell to 63.9m from 75.0m, a 14.8% decline; same-income EPS uplift would be about 17%.
evidence_table.result: verified; explicitly presented as a counterfactual calculation, not reported growth

evidence_table.claim: Nine-month OCF was USD1.084bn; cash USD1.633bn; long-term debt USD2.981bn; Q3 non-GAAP FCF USD275m, up 2.2%.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Release cash-flow table and 10-Q balance sheet/cash-flow statement.

fact_check_pass.method: Every material number, period, retention and contract-value definition, GAAP/non-GAAP measure and calculation was reread against Gartner's official release and Form 10-Q; prior-period impairment and share-count effects were checked separately.
